# megooflags_segment (Resource)

A segment: a reusable group of contexts that flag rules target with the in_segment operator. A context is in the segment when it is included, or matches a rule and is not excluded.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "megooflags_segment" "beta" {
  project     = megooflags_project.shop.key
  key         = "beta-testers"
  name        = "Beta testers"
  description = "People who try features first"
  included    = ["alice"]
  excluded    = ["mallory"]

  rules = [
    {
      description = "Staff"
      clauses = [
        { attribute = "email", operator = "ends_with", values_json = jsonencode(["@example.com"]) },
      ]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Segment key. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `project` (String) Project key. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `excluded` (Set of String) Context keys never in the segment, even when a rule matches.
- `included` (Set of String) Context keys always in the segment.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules. A context matching any rule is in the segment; a rule matches when all of its clauses match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `clauses` (Attributes List) Conditions on the context. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--clauses))

Optional:

- `description` (String) Description.

<a id="nestedatt--rules--clauses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.clauses`

Required:

- `operator` (String) Operator: in, not_in, contains, starts_with, ends_with, matches, lt, lte, gt, gte, semver_eq, semver_lt, semver_gt, before, after, in_segment.
- `values_json` (String) The values as a JSON array, for example jsonencode(["gold", 10]), so numbers and strings keep their types. For in_segment, the segment keys.

Optional:

- `attribute` (String) Context attribute.
- `negate` (Boolean) Invert the result.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <project>/<segment>.
terraform import megooflags_segment.beta shop/beta-testers
```
